name: ReMCP
tagline: Securely connect AI agents to computers you explicitly pair
description: ReMCP is a hosted remote MCP bridge for working with real files, terminals, screenshots, search, and processes on computers a user explicitly pairs. It uses MCP OAuth for user authorization and an outbound device agent, so users do not need to expose an inbound port on their computer.

install.notes: Complete the MCP OAuth browser flow, then pair a computer from https://remcp.site/app/connect.
